Spray Dried Garlic Powder Supplier for Seasoning and Food Manufacturers

Looking for a dependable spray dried garlic powder supplier for your seasonings, sauces or snacks? Tradenest Naturals supplies fine, aromatic garlic powder for industrial food production. Our focus is a steady flavor profile that holds up batch after batch. As a spray dried garlic powder supplier, we use careful drying to keep the sharp aroma and savory bite of fresh garlic.

Advanced Spray Drying Technology for Superior Quality

Production starts with garlic bulbs that are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The cloves are peeled, cleaned and processed, then spray dried into a fine powder. Fast drying helps hold on to garlic's volatile aroma compounds. Because we manage drying and packing ourselves, our bulk spray dried garlic powder stays stable in sealed packs. Your finished products keep a consistent taste from one batch to the next. Our garlic powder 80 mesh grade is sized for easy blending. In seasonings and instant soups it disperses evenly without lumps. This is why food companies work with us as a spray dried garlic powder exporter. We know that a steady ingredient protects your brand. So every batch is checked for moisture and mesh before it leaves our facility.

Why Choose Tradenest Naturals as Your Garlic Powder Bulk Supplier?

The right supplier makes your supply chain simpler. We aim to support your product, not just ship a bag. As a wholesale spray dried garlic powder supplier, we offer several practical advantages:
  • Cost Efficiency: An efficient process with little waste keeps your ingredient costs in check.
  • Long Shelf Life: Moisture is kept below 5%, giving a shelf life of 18-24 months in sealed packs.
  • Scalable Supply: We handle everything from 5 Kg trial lots to regular commercial orders.
  • Technical Support: Our team can help with application questions and dosage guidance.
Working directly with a spray dried garlic powder supplier also means a fair spray dried garlic powder price with no middleman margin. We focus on good value so you can grow your range.

Comprehensive Applications Across Industries

Garlic powder is used in many food categories. Snack makers use it in savory seasonings for chips, nuts and crackers. Instant food producers rely on it for quick, even flavor in soups, noodles and sauces. It also goes into marinades, dressings and spice blends. Supplement brands use it as a botanical ingredient. Composition details are listed on the specification sheet, which helps teams working on clean-label products.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried garlic powder supplier? The MOQ is 5 Kg. Larger volumes bring better pricing, and we also support small lots for R&D or private label trials. Contact our sales team for a quote. What certifications and quality standards apply? Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. Each lot carries a batch number for traceability, and we provide export documentation support. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? Packing options include 25 kg bulk bags, HDPE containers and OEM or private label pouches. Shelf life is 18-24 months when stored sealed in a cool, dry place. What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)? The standard grade is spray dried, 80 mesh, with moisture below 5%. Full composition is stated on the specification sheet. If you need a different particle size, please ask. What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote? Lead time depends on order volume and packing. Samples are available on request. Ask for a sample or a formal quote through our website inquiry form or contact our export team directly.

Commitment to Quality and Traceability

Quality starts with the raw material. Our garlic is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. During production, drying conditions and moisture are closely monitored. Each shipment is matched to the agreed specification before dispatch. Batch records let us trace every lot back through production. This openness is the basis for long-term trade relationships with importers in the USA, UK, Canada and Europe.
